notes: Fictional subject_object insert (ABox), new in the insert rebalance: two made-up particles in the real relation antiparticle_of (symmetric, functional). There is no real subject or object to count or rank, so all four derived queries are determinate (README, Insert (fictional)): each combines the edit with a real law of the relation (opposite charge, same mass, same spin, annihilation) and, where needed, a value given in the prompt about the other made-up particle. Logic: carrying a value across two individuals is fol, with arithmetic for the sign flip; annihilation is a class rule on the pair (dl). Answers are clear: −1 e gives +1 e; mass and spin carry over. The near query asks the same relation about a real pair (the positron), whose answer differs from the new answer and would catch a leak. Symmetry is left to the paraphrase rather than a derived slot (weak question, CRITERIA Rule 12). zh/es keep the made-up names.
